storage_policy.raw_data_location: External research storage only; never commit raw images, source metadata, checkpoints, calibration artifacts, or evaluation predictions to Git.
storage_policy.application_inference_policy: A dataset declaration or successful script run never enables application inference. Promotion requires the documented research, governance, and clinical-review gates.

scin.purpose: Diverse clinical dermatology image classification research
scin.training_scope: offline research only after license review and manifest-bound acquisition
scin.notes: SCIN records support dermatology research. This repository currently selects no hair or nail classifier from SCIN and does not claim patient-level splitting.

isic.notes: Collection-specific licensing and modality governance are required before use.

scin_like.purpose: Reserved for future, separately governed clinical-photo datasets

future_datasets.purpose: Reserved for future datasets after provenance, consent, label, split, and license review
